claim: The `MessagePackSecurity` copy constructor no longer copies `HashCollisionResistant`. Every derived instance therefore silently becomes non-collision-resistant, for example `MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth(100)` or any other `With*`/`Clone` path.
